infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location is used for optional leaving-home reminders, like keys, wallet, and phone.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location helps leaving-home reminders work when the app is not open.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Voice input is optional and helps create tasks from spoken phrases.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access lets you capture tasks and notes by voice.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access lets you choose a profile picture or attach photos of important documents to a nudge.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access lets you take a profile picture or photograph documents for a nudge.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID unlocks Nudge me Ready so your personal data stays private.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Calendar access lets you add appointments and events to your phone calendar.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Calendar access lets you add appointments and events to your phone calendar.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Contacts access lets you add guests to appointments from your phone contacts.
